d: 16 sal, 21 kes aur 50 se jyada beksur aurton ki hatyaen! yah khauphnak dastan hai telangana ke kukhyat siriyal kilar maina ramulu ki, jise 'bharat ka jaik da ripar' kaha gaya. 21 sal ki umr men patni ke chhor jane ki naphrat ne ramulu ko ek darinda bana diya. vah tari ki dukanon par akeli aurton ko nishana banata, sunsan ilakon men le jakar katl karta aur pahchan chhupane ke lie chehre jala deta tha. tin bar umrakaid, mental hospital se philmi pharari aur 500 sisitivi kaimron ki partal ke bad ek sigret ne kaise iska pardaphash kiya?
